title: LC25000 Clean Image Groups
subtitle: Tile-group annotations for leak-free splitting of LC25000
description:
Manually-verified tile-group annotations for the LC25000 lung and colon histopathology dataset.

LC25000 was created by augmenting 250 original tissue tiles per class (1,250 tiles total) with random rotations and flips, producing ~20 augmented copies per tile. Splitting the dataset randomly leaks copies of the same tile into both train and test sets (~98% of tile-groups are contaminated), inflating reported accuracy.

This dataset provides a single CSV (lc25000_image_groups.csv) assigning each of the 25,000 images to its original tile group (group_id), enabling proper group-aware train/test splitting.

Based on: Batchkala et al., 'Evaluating Histopathology Foundation Models for Few-Shot Tissue Clustering: An Application to LC25000 Augmented Dataset Cleaning', DEMI @ MICCAI 2024. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-73748-0_2

GitHub: https://github.com/GeorgeBatch/LC25000-clean

resources.description: One row per image (25,000 total). Maps each LC25000 image filename to its original tissue tile group, enabling group-aware train/test splitting that avoids augmentation-induced data leakage.

fields.name: stem
fields.description: Filename without extension (e.g. lungaca1352). Use this to match images regardless of file extension.

fields.name: filename
fields.description: Full image filename including extension (e.g. lungaca1352.jpeg).

fields.name: label
fields.description: Class name matching the dataset folder structure: colon_aca, colon_n, lung_aca, lung_n, or lung_scc.

fields.name: local_cluster_label
fields.description: Per-class tile group index (0-indexed, unique within each label). 243-257 groups per class.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Globally unique tile group id across all 5 classes (1,246 distinct values). Use this column as the groups argument in GroupShuffleSplit or StratifiedGroupKFold to prevent data leakage.
